name: Lithium Batteries
description: Guidelines for traveling with lithium batteries in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Spare lithium-ion or lithium-metal batteries must be carried in carry-on baggage only. Protecting the terminals is required.

checkedBag.reason: Spare lithium batteries are prohibited in checked baggage holds due to cargo fire hazards.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring lithium batteries on a plane?

travelTips: Spare lithium-ion or lithium-metal batteries must be carried in carry-on baggage only. Protecting the terminals is required.

faq.question: Is lithium batteries allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Lithium Batteries is allowed in carry-on luggage. Spare lithium-ion or lithium-metal batteries must be carried in carry-on baggage only. Protecting the terminals is required.

faq.question: Can you pack lithium batteries in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Lithium Batteries is not allowed in checked bags. Spare lithium batteries are prohibited in checked baggage holds due to cargo fire hazards.
